export memory timeline as an HTML file with embedded PNG plot showing GPU memory usage by category
export memory timeline as a JSON file with timestamps and sizes by category for a given device
export memory timeline as raw event tuples in JSON format with timestamp, action, numbytes, and category
run report_all_anti_patterns on a PyTorch profiler to detect performance anti-patterns and generate a TorchTidy report
review the ExtraCUDACopyPattern class that detects filling a CPU tensor and immediately moving it to GPU
review the FP32MatMulPattern class that detects FP32 matrix multiplications on TF32-capable GPUs

review the OptimizerSingleTensorPattern class that detects single-tensor optimizer usage and recommends foreach=True
review the BasicEvaluation class that computes self time, queue depth, and idle time from profiler results
summarize how BasicEvaluation.rank_events filters and ranks events by queue depth and idle time heuristics
test the BasicEvaluation.get_optimizable_events method that returns top N optimizable profiler events
refactor the EventKey.intervals_overlap method that calculates time overlap between an event and a list of intervals
build tree traversal utilities using traverse_dfs and traverse_bfs functions for profiling event hierarchies
test the is_available function to check if ITT feature is available
create an ITT range push with a descriptive ASCII message string
create an ITT range pop to end the current nested range span
create an ITT mark to describe an instantaneous event with a message
create a context manager range that pushes and pops ITT ranges automatically
create a torch profiler context manager to profile CPU and CUDA operations during model training
build a profiler schedule that skips initial steps, warms up, then records active iterations with repeat cycles
run a tensorboard trace handler that exports profiler chrome traces to a directory for tensorboard visualization
test the profiler schedule function with wait, warmup, active, and repeat parameters to control recording cycles
create an execution trace observer to register callbacks and start or stop event data recording
